# `aitbc liquidity-stake`

Stake tokens into an on-chain liquidity pool to earn rewards.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc liquidity-stake [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--wallet-name` | text | — | no | Name of the wallet to stake from |
| `--wallet-path` | text | — | no | Direct path to wallet file (overrides --wallet-name) |
| `--rpc-url` | text | — | no | Blockchain RPC URL (overrides config) |
| `--amount` | decimal | — | yes | Amount of AIT. |
| `--pool` | text | `main` | no | Liquidity pool name |
| `--lock-days` | integer | `0` | no | Lock period in days (higher APY) |
| `--fee` | decimal | `0.01` | no | Transaction fee in AIT |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc liquidity-stake --amount <amount>
RPC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8202/rpc
aitbc liquidity-stake --amount <amount> --rpc-url "$RPC_URL"
```
